evidence.title: Intended hosting declaration
evidence.purpose: Confirm repository hosting intent without asserting live state
evidence.acceptableForm: configuration excerpt with commit digest
evidence.acceptanceCriteria: autoscale and routing declarations match approved revision
evidence.freshnessRule: recollect on configuration or revision change
evidence.independentReview: independent reviewer compares commit and excerpt

evidence.title: Exact production target identity
evidence.purpose: Bind all evidence to one production target
evidence.acceptableForm: redacted signed target attestation
evidence.acceptanceCriteria: environment target database schema region revision and window are unambiguous
evidence.freshnessRule: invalidate on target or revision change
evidence.independentReview: compare with database and deployment identity

evidence.title: Environment separation
evidence.purpose: Prove development staging and production cannot be confused
evidence.acceptableForm: redacted environment inventory and separation policy
evidence.acceptanceCriteria: all environments and selectors are explicit
evidence.freshnessRule: recollect on environment configuration change

evidence.title: Deployed DB service inventory
evidence.purpose: Identify every deployed database-dependent service
evidence.acceptableForm: redacted service and revision inventory
evidence.acceptanceCriteria: API workers schedulers and startup paths are complete
evidence.freshnessRule: invalidate on scale rollout or service change

evidence.title: Dedicated read-only identity
evidence.purpose: Prove a distinct expiring diagnostic identity exists
evidence.acceptableForm: redacted role identity and expiry report
evidence.acceptanceCriteria: identity is dedicated attributable and time bounded
evidence.freshnessRule: invalidate on role or membership change

evidence.title: Effective read-only grants
evidence.purpose: Prove DDL and DML are unavailable
evidence.acceptableForm: redacted effective-grant report
evidence.acceptanceCriteria: no write owner bypass or unsafe function capability
evidence.freshnessRule: invalidate on grant schema or role change

evidence.title: No privilege escalation path
evidence.purpose: Prove SET ROLE and equivalent escalation are unavailable
evidence.acceptableForm: redacted role graph and policy attestation
evidence.acceptanceCriteria: no direct or transitive escalation route
evidence.freshnessRule: invalidate on membership or policy change

evidence.title: Connection cap enforcement
evidence.purpose: Limit collector concurrency to one connection
evidence.acceptableForm: signed enforcement report without credentials
evidence.acceptanceCriteria: second concurrent collector connection is prevented
evidence.freshnessRule: invalidate on collector or pool change

evidence.title: Statement timeout
evidence.purpose: Prove 15000 ms statement bound
evidence.acceptableForm: redacted setting attestation tied to session
evidence.acceptanceCriteria: effective value equals 15000 ms before statements
evidence.freshnessRule: recollect for every session

evidence.title: Lock timeout
evidence.purpose: Prove 1000 ms lock-wait bound
evidence.acceptableForm: redacted setting attestation tied to session
evidence.acceptanceCriteria: effective value equals 1000 ms
evidence.freshnessRule: recollect for every session

evidence.title: Idle transaction timeout
evidence.purpose: Prove 10000 ms idle transaction bound
evidence.acceptableForm: redacted setting attestation tied to session
evidence.acceptanceCriteria: effective value equals 10000 ms
evidence.freshnessRule: recollect for every session

evidence.title: Safe session closure
evidence.purpose: Prove cancel rollback reset release and audit behavior
evidence.acceptableForm: execution report with cleanup assertions
evidence.acceptanceCriteria: normal abort and connection-loss paths leave no session state
evidence.freshnessRule: recollect on collector pool or topology change

evidence.title: Autoscale configuration
evidence.purpose: Identify intended and active scaling model
evidence.acceptableForm: redacted autoscale policy and current state
evidence.acceptanceCriteria: policy target and revision match ENV evidence
evidence.freshnessRule: invalidate on scaling policy change

evidence.title: Active instances and revisions
evidence.purpose: Prove complete live process and revision set
evidence.acceptableForm: redacted instance revision and lifecycle inventory
evidence.acceptanceCriteria: all active draining and previous revisions included
evidence.freshnessRule: invalidate on deploy scale or restart

evidence.title: Worker and scheduler state
evidence.purpose: Account for concurrent background activity
evidence.acceptableForm: redacted worker scheduler and drain report
evidence.acceptanceCriteria: every instance job and active lease is accounted for
evidence.freshnessRule: invalidate on process or lease change

evidence.title: Startup DDL reachability
evidence.purpose: Determine whether deployed startup paths can mutate schema
evidence.acceptableForm: signed deployed-path inventory
evidence.acceptanceCriteria: all startup and post-listen mutation paths classified
evidence.freshnessRule: invalidate on revision change

evidence.title: Exclusive maintenance fence
evidence.purpose: Prove no request worker scheduler revision or startup path can write
evidence.evidenceSource: control plane telemetry and fence test
evidence.acceptableForm: signed execution report with negative bypass tests
evidence.acceptanceCriteria: global fence active for exact target and all writers rejected or drained
evidence.freshnessRule: invalidate on topology revision or fence change

evidence.title: Active backup configuration
evidence.purpose: Bind backup configuration to exact target
evidence.acceptableForm: redacted target-bound backup report
evidence.acceptanceCriteria: schedule scope and status are explicit
evidence.freshnessRule: invalidate on backup or target change

evidence.title: Retention and PITR
evidence.purpose: Prove active retention and point-in-time window
evidence.acceptableForm: redacted active setting plus policy reference
evidence.acceptanceCriteria: retention and PITR window meet approved policy
evidence.freshnessRule: invalidate on policy setting or target change

evidence.title: Latest successful backup
evidence.purpose: Prove a recent target-bound backup completed with integrity outcome
evidence.acceptableForm: redacted execution record and integrity result
evidence.acceptanceCriteria: target timestamp status and integrity are complete
evidence.freshnessRule: expire per approved RPO
evidence.independentReview: recovery reviewer verifies target and chronology

evidence.title: Successful restore rehearsal
evidence.purpose: Prove backups can actually be restored
evidence.acceptableForm: signed report with restore point timing checks and outcome
evidence.acceptanceCriteria: isolated restore succeeds and integrity checks pass
evidence.freshnessRule: expire per recovery policy or invalidate on platform change

evidence.title: Measured RPO and RTO
evidence.purpose: Compare recovery performance to approved objectives
evidence.acceptableForm: signed objectives-versus-results report
evidence.acceptanceCriteria: measured RPO and RTO satisfy approved values
evidence.freshnessRule: same expiry as restore rehearsal

evidence.title: Incident and database operators
evidence.purpose: Assign accountable abort-capable roles
evidence.acceptableForm: time-bound role assignments without personal data
evidence.acceptanceCriteria: incident DB recovery and escalation roles accept window
evidence.freshnessRule: invalidate on shift or assignment change

evidence.title: Abort procedure rehearsal
evidence.purpose: Prove abort and no-auto-retry behavior is usable
evidence.acceptableForm: timed execution report and observed outcomes
evidence.acceptanceCriteria: all eleven causes stop cleanly without repair or retry
evidence.freshnessRule: invalidate on procedure collector or topology change

evidence.title: Active monitors and alerts
evidence.purpose: Prove the window is observable and alerts reach operator
evidence.evidenceSource: monitoring control plane and test delivery
evidence.acquisitionMethod: approved monitor inventory and test alert
evidence.acceptableForm: redacted monitor state and delivery report
evidence.acceptanceCriteria: all required signals active and test alert acknowledged
evidence.freshnessRule: invalidate on monitor alert route or operator change

evidence.title: Approved resource thresholds
evidence.purpose: Define target-specific CPU IO lag lock and result abort limits
evidence.acceptableForm: signed threshold table with units windows and actions
evidence.acceptanceCriteria: every required signal has numeric approved abort threshold
evidence.freshnessRule: invalidate on topology workload or SLO change

evidence.title: Maximum diagnostic duration
evidence.purpose: Bound the complete operation independently of statement timeout
evidence.acceptableForm: signed elapsed-time limit and abort action
evidence.acceptanceCriteria: one target-specific end-to-end duration is approved
evidence.freshnessRule: invalidate on diagnostic or topology change

evidence.title: Documentation authorization
evidence.purpose: Record authority limited to package preparation
evidence.acceptableForm: instruction reference without fabricated signature
evidence.acceptanceCriteria: scope permits documentation only
evidence.freshnessRule: valid only for this package preparation

evidence.title: Production configuration-read approval
evidence.purpose: Authorize one scoped control-plane read
evidence.acceptableForm: signed time-bound approval record
evidence.acceptanceCriteria: scope target signers operations prohibitions and aborts complete
evidence.freshnessRule: expires at stated end or context change

evidence.title: Database and diagnostic approvals
evidence.purpose: Keep connection and diagnostic authority separate and scoped
evidence.acquisitionMethod: future explicit C then D approvals
evidence.acceptableForm: distinct signed time-bound approval records
evidence.acceptanceCriteria: C does not imply D and each diagnostic scope is exact
evidence.freshnessRule: expires at stated end or gate change

evidence.title: P-05 and retry approvals
evidence.purpose: Preserve separate E F and G decisions
evidence.acceptableForm: distinct signed records bound to capture scope and preflight
evidence.acceptanceCriteria: SCAN has unique successful PREFLIGHT and manual independent approval; retry is new
evidence.freshnessRule: invalidate on state target scope or preflight change

evidence.title: Status preservation proof
evidence.purpose: Prove preparation changed no authoritative status or production fact
evidence.evidenceSource: approved matrices validators and protected hashes
evidence.acceptableForm: validator report and Git diff
evidence.acceptanceCriteria: 1545 UNRESOLVED UNKNOWN facts 8304 links 85 hashes and P-05 digest preserved
evidence.freshnessRule: recollect on any input or package change
